speakers.speaker: 甄嬛
speakers.speaker_description: young#female#皇帝的宠妃，正与皇上商议追封太妃并出谋划策

speakers.speaker: 皇上
speakers.speaker_description: middle#male#清朝皇帝，听取甄嬛的建议并做出前朝后宫的职位安排

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: Then I ask you, my lord.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_zh: 追封温僖贵妃为贵太妃。
dialogue.text_en: Honor Consort Wenxi as Grand Consort.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: Give her a formal title,

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: and move her to the late emperor's tomb.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: At the same time,

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: we should [honor] all the other consorts in the palace

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: Give them new titles.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: Most of all, Consort Shouqi,

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: she should be the first among them.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: And for the Empress Dowager,

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: we must give her a high title,

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: to show your deep respect and love for her.

dialogue.speaker: 皇上
dialogue.text_en: Yes,

dialogue.speaker: 皇上
dialogue.text_en: he wants to honor his birth mother,

dialogue.speaker: 皇上
dialogue.text_en: so I will do it.

dialogue.speaker: 皇上
dialogue.text_zh: 为太后祝祷，祈求安康之名，
dialogue.text_en: As a prayer for the Empress Dowager health,

dialogue.speaker: 皇上
dialogue.text_zh: 为诸位太妃都加以尊号。
dialogue.text_en: Then I will give new titles to all the consorts.

dialogue.speaker: 皇上
dialogue.text_en: This way,

dialogue.speaker: 皇上
dialogue.text_en: the court and harem

dialogue.speaker: 皇上
dialogue.text_en: will all approve.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: Like this,

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_zh: 不仅言官不会有所议论，
dialogue.text_en: not only will the censors stay quiet,

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_zh: 宫中王爷太妃也会感沐皇上恩德。
dialogue.text_en: but the princes and consorts will also feel grateful for your kindness.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: But what about Prince Guo's birth mother,

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: Consort Shu is now a nun.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: How will you [arrange] things for her?

dialogue.speaker: 皇上
dialogue.text_en: The Seventeenth Prince will not care about such things.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: Even if he does not care,

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_zh: 只怕有些小人会因此揣度
dialogue.text_en: some mean people might still guess about it.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: They might think you look down on him.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: Maybe we should also,

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: show some extra kindness to Prince Guo.

dialogue.speaker: 皇上
dialogue.text_en: That is not hard at all.

dialogue.speaker: 皇上
dialogue.text_en: Since Consort Shu is a nun now,

dialogue.speaker: 皇上
dialogue.text_en: giving her a formal title is not proper.

dialogue.speaker: 皇上
dialogue.text_en: I will

dialogue.speaker: 皇上
dialogue.text_en: honor her from afar

dialogue.speaker: 皇上
dialogue.text_en: as Master Chongjing.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: Then,

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: everything is settled now.

dialogue.speaker: 皇上
dialogue.text_en: You truly are the one who understands me best.

dialogue.speaker: 皇上
dialogue.text_en: You can

dialogue.speaker: 皇上
dialogue.text_en: always look out for everything I need.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: You work so hard for the realm.

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_en: I do not understand state affairs,

dialogue.speaker: 甄嬛
dialogue.text_zh: 也只能在这些小事上为皇上留心了。
dialogue.text_en: I can only look out for you in these small things.

vocab_cards.speaker: 甄嬛
vocab_cards.original_sentence: we should honor all the other consorts in the palace
vocab_cards.simple_sentence: We honor our teachers on Teacher's Day.
vocab_cards.explanation_zh: honor 在这里是动词，意思是给予荣誉、尊敬。原句是 'we should honor all the other consorts in the palace'，意思是我们应该给宫里各位太妃都加以尊号。简单例句是 'We honor our teachers on Teacher's Day'，意思是我们教师节向老师表达敬意。

vocab_cards.speaker: 甄嬛
vocab_cards.original_sentence: How will you arrange things for her?
vocab_cards.simple_sentence: Please arrange the books on the desk.
vocab_cards.explanation_zh: arrange 的意思是安排、整理。原句是 'How will you arrange things for her?'，意思是皇上要如何安置她呢？简单例句是 'Please arrange the books on the desk'，意思是请把桌上的书整理好。
